planSteps.description: Navigate to / and wait for the login page to load
The page shows the heading 'Hola, Bienvenido!' and the label 'Seleccione una empresa'
Click the dropdown control under the label 'Seleccione una empresa' (the bordered box with the down arrow) to open the options list
Click the list item with visible text 'Admagro' inside the opened options list, then wait 5 seconds for the client connection to complete
The selected empresa shows 'Admagro' in the dropdown, and the 'Usuario' and 'Contraseña' inputs plus the 'Ingresar' button are enabled (not greyed out or disabled)
Type 'HOC' into the Usuario field and '1327' into the Contraseña field
Click the 'Ingresar' button and wait until the loading message 'Validando usuario...' disappears (allow up to 10 seconds)
The page shows the dashboard statistic title 'Total de bienes' and the sidebar navigation with the GABU logo
